title: ui-confirm: create StrawManTrap checklist
description: Create a StrawManTrap checklist component that guides users through identifying and avoiding straw man fallacies in their problem definitions. This interactive checklist presents common fallacy patterns and helps users validate that their antithesis arguments are fair and representative rather than oversimplified or misrepresented.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display a list of straw man fallacy indicators
THE SYSTEM SHALL allow users to check off items as they review their arguments

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL populate the checklist with relevant fallacy patterns based on the problem domain

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a user checks or unchecks an item
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL update the completion status and recalculate the trap-avoidance score

event_driven.trigger: WHEN all checklist items are reviewed
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a summary of the straw man risk assessment

unwanted.condition: IF the user rushes through the checklist without review
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT mark items as complete without explicit user action

unwanted.condition: IF the checklist cannot load fallacy patterns
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT proceed without indicating the error
unwanted.because: users need to know when validation tools are unavailable

preconditions: Problem context must be available for domain-specific pattern matching
Checklist item templates must be accessible from configuration or service
postconditions: Checked items are persisted with the problem confirmation record
Trap-avoidance score is calculated and available for quality metrics
invariants: Checklist items are never auto-checked without user interaction
Score calculation follows consistent weighting across sessions

happy: Given the checklist loads, when displayed, then shows all relevant straw man fallacy patterns for the problem domain
Given a user checks items, when interaction completes, then completion percentage updates in real-time
Given all items are checked, when complete, then shows summary with trap-avoidance score
error: Given a failure to load checklist items, when displayed, then shows error message with retry option
Given a user rapidly checks items, when saving, then debounces saves to prevent data loss
Given corrupted checklist state, when loading, then resets to clean state and notifies user
